style.styleTitle: Dibor Hampton Frosted Christmas Berries 50cm Wreath
style.toneOfVoice: <strong>A </strong>classical affair to decorate your door not only for Christmas, but all winter long, our extra large wreath follows the tradition that simplicity is sometimes best. Offering an impressive diameter, the base foliage consists of an array of evergreen pine leaves, all artfully arranged in a generous size for a truly impressive look.<br><br>For an eye-catching contrast, this giant wreath is studded with plentiful bushels of bright red berries, winking from amongst the botanical sprigs and playing into the time-honoured festive colour palette. To give our beautiful Christmas wreath the perfect finishing touch which really helps set it apart, the berries and needles are dusted with a soft flocked effect for pleasing texture and creating the impression of country hedgerows that have been kissed with fresh snowfall. An everlasting alternative to fresh arrangements that you can display year upon year, the botanical elements are all densely packed all around a lovingly crafted frame of interwoven grapevine branches that s both stylish and robust.<br><br>• Dia. 50cm<br>• Size: ONE<br>• Height 50cm<br>• Width 50cm<br>• Depth 50cm
